body: P1: The declared Ed25519/ES256 algorithm must be bound to the actual public-key type and, for ES256, the P-256 curve; otherwise an RSA key can be accepted under the ES256 label. Enforce key type/curve and add regression coverage.
author: Codex

replies.body: Fixed: createPublicKey metadata now requires Ed25519 or EC prime256v1 to match the declared algorithm; RSA-under-ES256 regression is covered.
replies.author: Codex

body: P1: Sandbox confirmation must reject URL query parameters because PostgreSQL connection options can override the visible localhost host/port. Require an empty query/fragment and cover the bypass attempt.
author: Codex

replies.body: Fixed: sandbox validation rejects all query parameters and fragments before Pool construction; a host-override query regression is covered.
replies.author: Codex
